dedupe_keys.name: mapsearch north american natural gas pipeline and facility gis data commercial

description: MAPSearch sells a North American pipeline GIS database for the natural gas industry, covering natural gas, gas liquids, specialty gases and LNG. The product page lists all pipeline types, namely transmission, trunkline, gathering and interconnects, and facility layers for biogas production, carbon capture and storage, chemical plants, CO2 and gas processing plants, compressor stations, delivery points to industrial and power plants, distribution and receiving terminals, fractionators, import, export and dock facilities, LNG terminals, meter stations, market hubs, offshore platforms, storage and tank farms, truck unloading, underground storage and wellhead meters. Attributes include owner and operator with previous owner and operator, number of owners, lease status, primary and secondary commodity, pipeline type, operating status, diameter, direction of flow, gathering system affiliation, facility capacities, spatial and attribute update dates and source metadata. A product sheet gives licensing details. Access is a paid commercial licence, with pricing and sample data available on request by email; no delivery format is stated on the page read. Coverage is North America. Caveats: proprietary data that cannot be shared openly, and update frequency is not stated on the page. Simulation uses are pipeline network topology with diameters and flow direction for gas network and hazard exposure models. Related records: data-rextag-natural-gas-and-misc-gases-gis-datasets is a competing commercial product.
